answer: A capped admission auction blocks sybil floods. Each epoch opens 50 entry slots; agents bid sealed for one slot, top 50 win and pay, losers refunded. An attacker needing 100 fake seats must win 100 slots, paying 100 x 25 = 2,500 POA, while one honest agent pays 25 POA once. Extra fakes act like a rising tide, pushing prices higher per copy. Honest agents pay one fee at dawn, stay on the cheap side of the ledge, and keep rewards undiluted.
